summary_rationale: EQT Corporation is the premier low-cost, vertically integrated natural gas producer in North America, combining 28.0 Tcfe of proved reserves (93% Marcellus) with owned Equitrans gathering/transmission infrastructure and the 2.0 Bcf/d Mountain Valley Pipeline. Management (CEO Toby Rice and CFO Jeremy Knop) has consistently delivered sub-$1.10/Mcfe operating costs ($1.03-$1.09/Mcfe in Q1-Q3 2026), a ~$2.00/MMBtu unlevered FCF breakeven, $2.80B of FY2025 FCF, and rapid post-Equitrans deleveraging from ~$14B peak debt down to $5.6B total debt ($5.5B net debt) as of September 30, 2026. All six leading operational KPIs pass. However, EQT's business quality verdict is CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than COMPOUNDER_PASS because ~65%+ of operating income remains tied to volatile Henry Hub and Appalachian basis cycles, Permian associated gas poses a structural supply overhang, trailing ROIC (~8.56%) hovers near WACC across full-cycle capital intensity, and serial equity-funded M&A (3.69x share count expansion FY2016-FY2025, plus the pending $13B all-stock Range Resources merger) introduces ongoing integration and per-share compounding execution tests.
